national_news.title: World Stroke Day Observed to Raise Awareness on Stroke Warning Signs
bullets: World Stroke Day was observed with the campaign message 'Every Minute Counts – Know the Signs of Stroke' to highlight timely medical action.
Union Health Minister JP Nadda urged citizens to recognise warning signs like facial drooping, arm weakness, and speech difficulty.
AIIMS New Delhi experts reported approximately 18 lakh stroke cases annually in India, with high blood pressure identified as a leading risk factor.

national_news.title: Sports, Education Ministries and UNESCO Sign MoU for Clean Sport Values
bullets: The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Ministry of Education, and UNESCO exchanged an MoU to introduce the 'Sports Values in Every Classroom Toolkit'.
The initiative aims to embed values such as respect, integrity, and fairness into school children through everyday classroom activities.
Toolkit video modules will be made accessible in 13 Indian languages to reach students nationwide and build a fair sporting ecosystem.

national_news.title: Union Cabinet Approves Container Manufacturing Scheme, DA Hike and PMVGSY
bullets: Approved the Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme with a ₹10,000 crore outlay up to FY 2039-40 to boost domestic shipping container production.
Sanctioned a 3% hike in Dearness Allowance (DA) and Dearness Relief for over 48 lakh central government employees and 68 lakh pensioners effective July 1, 2026.
Cleared the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana (PMVGSY) with a ₹7,395 crore outlay (2026-27 to 2030-31) to empower over 2.78 lakh rural local bodies.

national_news.title: Prime Minister Narendra Modi chairs 54th PRAGATI meeting
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi chaired the 54th meeting of PRAGATI (Pro-Active Governance and Timely Implementation) at Seva Teerth in New Delhi.
Reviewed infrastructure projects across Railways, Ekta Malls, and Drug Parks worth over ₹16,000 crore covering 31 States and Union Territories.
Highlighted that nearly 25 crore people have moved out of multidimensional poverty through sustained governance efforts and welfare schemes.

national_news.title: Central Bureau of Communication Organizes Vigilance Awareness Workshop
bullets: The Central Bureau of Communication (CBC) and Press Information Bureau (PIB) organized a one-day workshop on vigilance awareness under the theme "Probity for Prosperity" in Jammu.
The workshop focused on promoting integrity, transparency, accountability, and ethical conduct in public administration.
Discussions highlighted the Public Interest Disclosure and Protection of Informers (PIDPI) Resolution, outlining mechanisms for reporting corruption while protecting the identity of informants.

national_news.title: Department of Pharmaceuticals Implements Special Campaign 6.0
bullets: The Department of Pharmaceuticals, under the Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilisers, conducted over 14,700 cleanliness drives across field offices during Special Campaign 6.0 held from October 2 to October 31.
The initiative successfully freed up 2,200 square feet of office space, weeded out 489 physical files, and generated ₹2.30 lakh from scrap disposal.
The campaign focuses on scientific e-waste management, prompt grievance redressal via CPGRAMS, and improving administrative efficiency.

national_news.title: NSIC Presents Dividend of ₹47.76 Crore for FY 2025-26 to Government
bullets: National Small Industries Corporation Limited (NSIC), a Schedule 'A' Mini Ratna Company under the Ministry of MSME, presented a dividend of ₹47.76 crore for FY 2025-26 to the Union Minister for MSME.
NSIC reported a robust financial performance with a total revenue of ₹3,767 crore and a Profit After Tax (PAT) of ₹159 crore.
The corporation continues to play a pivotal role in promoting entrepreneurship, skill development, and strengthening the micro and small enterprise ecosystem in India.

national_news.title: Ayush Ministry and IIT Bombay Launch National Innovation Challenge for AI in Ayurveda
bullets: The All India Institute of Ayurveda (AIIA), under the Ministry of Ayush, launched the National Innovation Challenge during its sixth foundation day celebrations of AIIA-iCAINE.
Organized by TechFest, IIT Bombay, the challenge utilizes IIT Bombay's open-source Ayurveda Large Language Model, 'AyurParam', to develop secure and practical AI solutions for Ayurveda.

Strategic MoUs were signed to establish the 'AI in Ay' Secretariat for Artificial Intelligence in Ayurveda with the World Ayurveda Foundation and to partner with Reliance Retail Limited for commercial skincare products.

national_news.title: Union Health Minister Reviews Cleanliness Initiatives Under Special Campaign 6 at AIIMS New Delhi
bullets: Union Health Minister JP Nadda reviewed cleanliness, sanitation, and waste management initiatives under Special Campaign 6 at AIIMS, New Delhi.

He inspected the newly constructed Patient Waiting Lounge (proposed as an Aashray Shelter) at the AIIMS Trauma Centre Extension Campus, built by BEL under CSR initiatives with a seating capacity of 897.
AIIMS highlighted major sustainability achievements, including reusing 19.6 lakh litres of treated wastewater daily and reducing electricity consumption by 7.68 lakh kWh.

national_news.title: INS Trishul Concludes Port Call in Italy to Strengthen Bilateral Maritime Cooperation
bullets: Indian Naval Ship (INS) Trishul concluded its port call at Civitavecchia, Italy, as part of its operational deployment in the Mediterranean Sea.
Engagements included professional interactions, cross-deck visits, and meetings between the Commanding Officer of INS Trishul and the Fleet Commander of the Italian Navy.
The ship was visited by India's Ambassador to Italy, Vani Rao, and senior Italian naval officials, reinforcing bilateral defence ties.

national_news.title: Union Minister C R Patil chairs 19th meeting of Ganga Flood Control Board
bullets: The 19th meeting of the Ganga Flood Control Board (GFCB) was held at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, chaired by Union Minister of Jal Shakti C R Patil.

The Jal Shakti Minister launched the 'Punah Bharan' Mobile App, developed by BISAG-N in collaboration with the National Water Mission, to scientifically identify locations for artificial groundwater recharge.

The Board reviewed the restructuring of the Ganga Flood Control Commission (GFCC) and emphasized risk-based basin Master Plans, river morphology studies, and the Flood Management Information System (FMIS).
The Ganga Flood Control Board was originally constituted by the Government of India on 18 April 1972 to address flood, erosion, and drainage problems in the Ganga Basin.

national_news.title: MoU Signed to Introduce 'Sports Values in Every Classroom Toolkit' Across India
bullets: The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Ministry of Education, and UNESCO exchanged an MoU to introduce the 'Sports Values in Every Classroom Toolkit' across India.
The initiative aims to integrate core values such as respect, integrity, and fairness in children through everyday classroom activities and sports.
Video modules under the toolkit will be translated into 13 Indian languages to reach students across the country and strengthen sporting integrity.

national_news.title: Union Cabinet Approves Major Schemes for Shipping Containers, Sports Goods, and Panchayats
bullets: Approved the Container Manufacturing Promotion Scheme with an outlay of Rs 10,000 crore over 13 years (up to FY 2039-40) to boost domestic shipping container production.
Sanctioned the Khelo India Sports Goods Manufacturing Scheme (outlay of Rs 1,856 crore for 2026–34) to establish dedicated Sports Goods Manufacturing Zones (SGMZs).
Approved the Pradhan Mantri Viksit Gram Swaraj Yojana (PMVGSY) with Rs 7,395 crore outlay (2026–31) to empower over 2.78 lakh Rural Local Bodies.

national_news.title: EAM S. Jaishankar to Attend G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting and CHOGM
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar will participate in the G20 Foreign Ministers' Meeting in Atlanta, US, and a QUAD Foreign Ministers' Meeting on the sidelines.
He will attend the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting (CHOGM) in Antigua and Barbuda under the theme 'Accelerating Partnerships and Investment for a Prosperous Commonwealth'.
India announced it will host the SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum meeting in New Delhi from November 20 to 22.

national_news.title: PM Modi Addresses Emerging Science, Technology and Innovation Conclave in New Delhi
bullets: PM Narendra Modi addressed the 3-day Emerging Science, Technology and Innovation Conclave in New Delhi, emphasizing innovation in critical and emerging technologies.
Highlighted major milestones including the 500-MW Prototype Fast Breeder Reactor achieving first criticality and India's annual patent filings reaching nearly 1.5 lakh.
Announced a government commitment of Rs 12,000 crore matched by Rs 12,000 crore from private investors for market-ready lab technologies.

national_news.title: India to Amend National Anti-Doping Act to Introduce Criminal Provisions
bullets: Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports Mansukh Mandaviya announced plans to introduce criminal provisions to the National Anti-Doping Act.
The proposed amendment aims to strengthen action against doping violations, specifically targeting coaches and supply chain stakeholders.
India's current anti-doping framework is governed by the National Anti-Doping Act, 2022, and its 2025 Amendment, with NADA conducting over 7,000 tests during 2025-26.

national_news.title: Cyclonic Storm Arnab Lashes Southern Odisha
bullets: Severe cyclonic storm Arnab crossed the Andhra Pradesh coast between Bapatla and Visakhapatnam, bringing heavy rainfall and strong winds to southern Odisha districts including Ganjam, Gajapati, Koraput, Malkangiri, and Nabarangpur.

The India Meteorological Department (IMD) issued a red warning for five districts and an orange warning for several other parts of the state as wind speeds reached 125 to 135 km/h with gusts up to 145 km/h.
State authorities shifted over one lakh people from vulnerable areas to safer locations, while train and bus services were severely disrupted.

national_news.title: Goa Entrepreneur Success Highlighted Under National SARAS Mela 2026
bullets: Siddhi, an entrepreneur from North Goa, scaled her Instagram-based ethnic wear venture to an annual turnover of Rs 60 lakh, employing 7 to 10 people with international shipping.
Her entrepreneurial journey was featured by the Press Information Bureau (PIB) as part of the government's National SARAS Mela 2026.
She received crucial guidance and support from the Mahamaya Self-Help Group (SHG) for connecting with workers, craft skills, and marketing workshops.

national_news.title: Mobile PLI Scheme Generates Rs 25,000 Crore in Direct Taxes
bullets: Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw stated that the government's mobile phone production-linked incentive (PLI) scheme generated Rs 25,000 crore in direct taxes against an incentive payout of Rs 19,000 crore.
The electronics manufacturing sector currently employs 25 lakh people, with mobile manufacturing alone accounting for 12 lakh jobs.
The Union Cabinet approved the subsequent Mobile Phone Manufacturing Scheme (MPMS) with a budgetary outlay of Rs 62,500 crore, running from FY 2026-27 to FY 2030-31.

national_news.title: India and HD Hyundai Advance Rs 38,000 Crore Thoothukudi Mega Shipyard Project
bullets: Union Minister Sarbananda Sonowal met HD Hyundai Chairman Chung Ki-sun in Seoul to advance the proposed greenfield shipyard at Thoothukudi, Tamil Nadu.
The project is valued at Rs 38,000 crore (approx. $4 billion) with an annual capacity of 2.5 million Gross Tonnage, aiming to be India's largest commercial shipyard.
The initiative aligns with India's Maritime Amrit Kaal Vision 2047, which targets an annual shipbuilding output of 4.5 million GT by 2047.

national_news.title: India and Mexico Formally Launch Negotiations for a Preferential Trade Agreement
bullets: India and Mexico signed Terms of Reference (ToR) to launch negotiations for a Preferential Trade Agreement (PTA) to expand bilateral trade and supply chains.
The agreement follows a meeting between PM Narendra Modi and Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum at the G7 Summit in June 2025.
Bilateral trade between India and Mexico stood at USD 7.83 billion in 2025-26, covering sectors like automobiles, chemicals, electronics, and pharmaceuticals.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Cabinet Approves AI Policy 2026 to Boost Technology and Startups
bullets: The Bihar Cabinet chaired by Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary approved the Bihar Artificial Intelligence Policy 2026 on October 28, 2026.
The policy offers capital investment subsidies, cloud infrastructure usage incentives, SGST reimbursement, and power tariff subsidies to AI companies and GCCs.
The state government aims to train 500,000 young people in AI over five years and has partnered with IIT Patna and tech giants like Google and Microsoft.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Completes Aadhaar Seeding for 95.12% of Social Security Pensioners
bullets: Bihar successfully completed Aadhaar seeding for 1.03 crore social security pension beneficiaries, achieving a coverage of 95.12%.
The Mukhyamantri Vridhjan Pension Yojana recorded the highest number of Aadhaar-seeded beneficiaries at over 54.17 lakh.
Madhubani district recorded the highest number of beneficiaries with completed Aadhaar seeding in the state.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Museum Ranks 9th Globally in Worth a Journey's 2026 List
bullets: Patna's Bihar Museum secured the 9th rank in Worth a Journey's 2026 list of the world's 100 best museums, outranking New York's The Met and Paris's Louvre.
It is the highest-ranked museum in Asia and the only Indian institution featured in the top 100 of this list.
Established in 2015 and spread over 13 acres, the museum was designed by renowned Japanese architect Fumihiko Maki.

bihar_news.title: ICAR-CIFE Kolkata Organises Internship on Diversified Aquaculture for Bihar Students
bullets: ICAR-Central Institute of Fisheries Education (CIFE), Kolkata Centre, conducted a 14-day internship for 16 B.F.Sc. students from RDS College, Muzaffarpur, Bihar.
The training covered modern aquaculture technologies including biofloc systems, RAS, aquaponics, and pearl farming.
Field visits included Nalban sewage-fed aquaculture facilities and ornamental fish breeding units in Howrah.

bihar_news.title: Patna Becomes Bihar's First Municipality to Issue Municipal Bonds
bullets: Patna is preparing to borrow Rs 200 crore via municipal bonds, becoming Bihar's first-ever municipal bond issuer and the first in India for the fiscal year.
The 10-year borrowing aims to fund crucial infrastructural renewal such as sewage treatment, drainage, and water supply.
World Bank assessments highlight that India needs $840 billion in urban infrastructure investment from 2021 to 2036.

bihar_news.title: Delhi Government Sends Proposal for Direct AC Luxury Buses to Bihar
bullets: The Delhi Transport Department sent a proposal to Lieutenant Governor Taranjit Singh Sandhu for final approval to launch direct inter-state bus services to Bihar.
The project aims to deploy over 50 air-conditioned luxury buses connecting Delhi with seven locations in Bihar, targeting a launch before the Chhath festival.
The MoU for the project has already been approved by both the Delhi and Bihar governments to ease travel congestion during festive seasons.

bihar_news.title: Delhi-Bihar AC Luxury Bus Service Planned Ahead of Chhath Festival
bullets: Delhi Transport Department planned a fleet of over 50 AC luxury buses under a wet-lease arrangement with private operators to connect Delhi with seven Bihar destinations.
Cities under consideration for the service include Patna, Gaya, Muzaffarpur, Darbhanga, Purnia, and Bhagalpur.
The initiative aims to provide an alternative travel option for migrant workers and families travelling during the heavy rush of Chhath Puja.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Combined Entrance Examination Board Postpones MBBS/BDS Stray Round Allotment
bullets: The Bihar Combined Entrance Examination Board (BCECEB) postponed the stray round seat allotment result for NEET MBBS and BDS admissions 2026.
The stray round serves as the final opportunity for eligible candidates to secure vacant medical and dental college seats in the state based on merit rank.
Candidates were advised to monitor the official BCECEB portal for the revised schedule and keep their documents ready for reporting.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Announces Plans for Signature Roads Across All Cities to Support Urbanization
bullets: Bihar Urban Development and Housing Minister Nitish Mishra announced plans to develop signature roads across all cities to manage faster urbanization.
Currently, approximately 11% of Bihar's population lives in urban areas compared to the national average of 33%.
The infrastructure push includes planned satellite townships, improved connectivity, and the integration of modern technology and project monitoring in public works.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Delegation Studies Maharashtra's Panchayati Raj System in Nashik
bullets: A high-level delegation from Bihar's Panchayati Raj Department, led by Director Naveen Kumar Singh (IAS), visited the Nashik Zilla Parishad in Maharashtra.
The primary objective of the exposure visit was to conduct a comparative study on administrative structures, internal revenue generation, and financial empowerment of local self-government bodies.
Discussions centered on fund allocation processes, administrative-political coordination, and effective execution of development projects across Gram Panchayats and Zilla Parishads.

bihar_news.title: Gyan Bhadra's Book 'The Advent of a Statesman' on Bihar's Governance Released in Delhi
bullets: A new book titled 'The Advent of a Statesman: Bihar Has Never Had It So Good', authored by journalist Gyan Bhadra, was launched at the Press Club of India in New Delhi.
The publication was formally unveiled by Press Club of India President Sangeeta Barooah Pisharoty during a literature festival.
The book critically examines Bihar's development trajectory, governance challenges, agricultural distress, institutional capacity, and political leadership.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Introduces Performance Assessment Index for Banks; Muzaffarpur Startup Innovates Corn Husk Utensils
bullets: The Bihar government introduced a 100-point performance assessment index to rank state banks; IDFC FIRST Bank topped the evaluation with 74 points.
As of September 30, 2026, Bihar achieved 38.25% (₹1.89 lakh crore) of its ₹4.95 lakh crore Annual Credit Plan target for 2026–27, with the state Credit-Deposit Ratio (CDR) standing at 60.17%.

Naz Ozair, an engineer from Muradpur in Muzaffarpur district, established MNO Swadeshi India Pvt. Ltd. and patented technology to convert discarded corn husks into single-use plastic utensil alternatives.
